subject: SIG questionnaire — access controls: SSO/SCIM/RBAC follow-up and evidence
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greg Ortiz <g.ortiz@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up: access control evidence and timelines

Hannah — thanks for the initial SIG submission. A couple of clarifications from our security team around the access control section:

1) SSO / SAML: can you provide the SAML metadata (IdP/SP endpoints, certificates) and a short explanation of how SAML sessions are invalidated on logout/credential rotation?

2) SCIM / user provisioning: we need a sample mapping for Acme (attributes included, write-only attrs), and a recent provisioning audit showing create/update/delete events for a test user.

3) RBAC / least privilege: please send the role matrix for admin vs product roles and any documented process for granting elevated access (approval path, approval TTL).

4) MFA & admin protection: confirm MFA enforcement for all user and admin consoles and how you detect/enforce bypass attempts.

Can you share those artifacts and a short auditor-friendly cover note by end of day Tuesday (2027-01-19)? If you need a short window to run a SCIM test, tell us when and we can schedule.

Thanks,
Sam
Samantha Lee
Security Program Lead — Acme Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: access control evidence and timelines

Sam — thanks for the clarity and the deadline. We can provide the requested artifacts. High-level responses below; attachments and logs to follow Tuesday:  

- SSO / SAML: we will attach the SP metadata (endpoint URLs + signing cert) and a short note on session invalidation and cert rotation cadence (30 days rotation for signing certs; session revocation via Redis-backed session store and explicit SAML logout endpoint).

- SCIM / provisioning: propose a staged SCIM test for Acme in our staging tenant on Tue 1/19 10:00–11:00 PST — during that window we will perform a create/update/delete and export the provisioning audit log. We will attach a sample attribute mapping (Name, email, externalId, roles).

- RBAC & least privilege: attaching an RBAC matrix with default role-to-permission mappings and our elevation flow (ticket in Jira + manager approval; elevated access is time-boxed).

- MFA & admin protection: MFA is enforced for all interactive logins (user console) and required for admin roles via conditional policy. We will include an auditor statement and relevant auth logs.

Next steps: Dev will attach the SAML metadata and RBAC matrix tomorrow; Monica will generate the provisioning log and auditor-cover note. If Acme wants the SCIM test at a different time, tell us.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Trust & Security Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Sam — attaching the SP SAML metadata and the RBAC matrix for Acme. Notes: 
- SAML endpoints in the metadata are the production endpoints; we can provide a staging metadata if you prefer a test run.
- Signing certs rotate on a 30-day cadence; we publish metadata to our internal key service and rotate the SP certs with zero-downtime key rollover.
- Logout: we support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated logout; sessions are additionally invalidated server-side (short session TTLs for admin scopes).

Attachment stubs: redwood-saml-metadata.xml (SP metadata), rbac-matrix-acme.xlsx (role -> permission matrix).

I can enable the SCIM test in staging for 1/19 10:00 PST and capture the provisioning audit log. Confirm and I'll kick off the run.

Summary: 
- Provisioning evidence: scim-test-provisioning-log-20270119.csv includes timestamped CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE events for test user externalId acme-td-123, with actor "redwood-scim-service" for automated actions and the operator for manual updates.
